insight.headline: OrderCreate Mutation
insight.what_changed: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment. A trackingNumbers field has been added to OrderCreateFulfillmentInput. This allows attaching multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.
insight.developer_impact: Developers using the orderCreate mutation to import orders should update their code to utilize the new trackingNumbers field. This change provides more flexibility in tracking shipments. The GraphQL Admin API has been updated to reflect this change, so developers should review their API calls to ensure compatibility. No migration is required, but developers should test their code to ensure it works as expected with the updated API.
insight.merchant_impact: Merchants will have more accurate and detailed tracking information for their orders, improving the overall shipping experience for their customers.
insight.why_it_matters: This change improves the functionality of the orderCreate mutation, allowing for more accurate tracking and better customer experience. It also reflects Shopify's commitment to enhancing its APIs and improving developer experience.

updates.title: @shopify/cli-hydrogen@13.0.4
updates.summary: A new flag --javascript-origin has been added to override the hydrogen customer-account-push default origin. Local Hydrogen CLI discovery has also been fixed.

updates.title: @shopify/mini-oxygen@4.2.2
updates.summary: MiniOxygen now supports HTTP/2 requests in its Vite request conversion.

updates.title: @shopify/hydrogen@2026.4.5
updates.summary: Customer account login recovery has been improved when switching browser contexts or opening multiple login tabs. OAuth state values now use cryptographically secure randomness.

updates.title: skeleton@2026.4.6
updates.summary: Newly scaffolded storefronts now recommend the Shopify AI Toolkit. Dependencies have also been updated.

updates.title: @shopify/create-hydrogen@5.0.39
updates.summary: The create-hydrogen package now recommends the Shopify AI Toolkit in newly scaffolded storefronts.

updates.title: Shop Campaigns performance data now available via ShopifyQL
updates.summary: Shop Campaigns performance data is now available via ShopifyQL, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query data on behalf of authorized merchants.
The CLI now serves UI extension source maps during app development.

updates.title: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes
updates.summary: Standard storefront events and actions now support cart attributes, including updating cart attributes and firing a new event when an attributes update is initiated.

updates.title: Draft order and transfer/shipment inventory is moving from reserved to committed
updates.summary: Inventory that was previously tracked under the reserved quantity state for draft orders, transfers, and shipments is being moved to the committed state.

updates.title: WebMCP support for Liquid and Hydrogen storefronts
updates.summary: Online stores now expose WebMCP tools that AI agents can call, allowing agents to search the catalog, manage the shopper's cart, and go to checkout on the shopper's behalf.

updates.title: Oxygen is now available on development stores
updates.summary: Oxygen is now available on development stores, allowing deployment of Hydrogen storefronts from dev stores.

updates.title: The `orderCreate` mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment
updates.summary: The orderCreate mutation now supports multiple tracking numbers for each fulfillment, allowing attachment of multiple tracking numbers to a fulfillment when importing orders.

recap.headline: Hydrogen updates and ShopifyQL expansion dominate the week

themes.title: Hydrogen Updates
themes.detail: Multiple Hydrogen-related packages received updates, including @shopify/cli-hydrogen, @shopify/mini-oxygen, @shopify/hydrogen, and @shopify/create-hydrogen, with improvements such as HTTP/2 request support, customer account login recovery, and recommendations for the Shopify AI Toolkit. These updates aim to enhance the development experience and storefront performance.

themes.title: ShopifyQL Expansion
themes.detail: ShopifyQL now includes the shop_campaign_insights schema, allowing analytics and reporting apps to query Shop Campaigns performance data on behalf of authorized merchants. This expansion enables more detailed performance analysis and insights for merchants.

actions.text: Update Hydrogen projects to the latest versions
